name: Thor
diceAnatomy: 1-3 = Hammer (A), 4-5 = Worthy (B), 6 = Thunder (C). Vérifié leaflet (scan user 2026-07-06).
source: characters/Thor/ scans 2026-07-06 (board 3 photos, leaflet 4 captures, 15 cartes) — SPEC.md + rulings user

tokens.name: Electrokinesis
tokens.description: Positive. Boosts abilities (+1 dmg x EK sur Bottled Lightning/Odinforce). Once per turn, spend 4 during Main Phase to draw 1.

tokens.name: Guard Break
tokens.description: Positive. At the conclusion of your Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack: spend and roll 1 die — on 4-5, the Attack becomes undefendable. (Ruling user : dépense libre, jeton par jeton.)

companion.name: Mjölnir
companion.description: Begins on Thor's board. Throw (home -> opponent): 1 isolated undefendable dmg. Retrieve (opponent -> home): gain 1 Electrokinesis. At ANY time, discard a card to Throw or Retrieve. Abilities do it for free.

abilities.effect: Gain 2 Guard Break, Heal 2. If Mjölnir home: gain 3 EK. Otherwise Retrieve -> 3 collateral dmg.
Roll 3 dice: deal dmg = total of any two. +2 isolated collateral.
Roll 5: >=2 Hammer -> Throw/Retrieve; >=2 Worthy -> +1 CP; +1 EK per Thunder. Then +1 dmg x EK.
Throw/Retrieve x2. Gain 2 Guard Break. Then deal 7 + 1 x EK.
9 dmg if opponent has Mjölnir, otherwise gain 1 EK.
Gain Guard Break. Throw/Retrieve up to 4 times. Deal 14 dmg.

altAbilities.effect: Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir up to SIX times.

defense.name: Thunder Wheel
defense.text: Defense Roll 3. On >=2 Hammer: Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir (II: for EVERY pair). Prevent 2 x Worthy. Gain 1 EK per Thunder.

cards.name: Hammered II
cards.text: 3/4/5 Hammers: 5/6/7 dmg. Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir. On 4-of-a-kind (#'s), gain Electrokinesis.

cards.name: Hammered III
cards.text: 3/4/5 Hammers: 5/6/8 dmg. Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), gain Electrokinesis.

cards.name: Mighty Summon II
cards.text: Heal 3, collateral 4. Adds alt BOOM BOOM! (HH+TT): Gain 2 Electrokinesis. Deal 6 dmg.

cards.name: Chain Lightning II
cards.text: Roll 4 dice: deal dmg = total of any two. +3 isolated collateral.

cards.name: Odinforce II
cards.text: Deal 6 dmg & roll 5. You may re-roll up to 5 of these dice (once). Then add 1 dmg x Electrokinesis.

cards.name: Bottled Lightning II
cards.text: Throw/Retrieve x3. 8 dmg + 1 x EK. Adds alt RICOCHET! (TTT): Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir up to six times.

cards.name: Lightning Rod II
cards.text: Small Straight: Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir. Gain Electrokinesis. Deal 9 dmg.

cards.name: Thunder Bolt II
cards.text: Large Straight: 12 dmg. Adds alt ASGARDIAN BRAWN (WWW): Heal 4.

cards.name: Thunder Wheel II
cards.text: Defense Roll 4. For every 2 Hammers, Throw or Retrieve Mjölnir. Prevent 2 x Worthy. Gain 1 EK per Thunder.

cards.name: Indomitable Will!
cards.text: Play only after being Attacked. If the incoming Attack would reduce your Health to 0, roll 1 die: on Worthy (4-5), set your Health to 1 instead.

cards.name: Invulnerability!
cards.text: Discard 2 Electrokinesis to prevent all incoming damage.

cards.name: He Is Worthy!
cards.text: Change the value of any one of your dice to a 4 or 5.

cards.name: Time to Hammer!
cards.text: Retrieve Mjölnir. Gain 1 CP and Electrokinesis.

cards.name: Stormbreak!
cards.text: Play only if you have Thrown Mjölnir twice this turn. Draw 1. Gain 1 CP, Guard Break, and Electrokinesis.
